config.about: Optic lobe single-cell atlas across development: P15, P30, P50, P70 (hours APF) and Adult (devstages/_h5ad/*.h5ad). Cell type = MultiomeAnnotated (shared labels across stages); metacluster, temporal/spatial origin and Notch from the PNAS table via MultiomeNN. Each stage keeps its own stored tSNE; use split by stage. Genes = those measured at every stage.
